key.name: last-library-path
key.description: Path of the library reopened at startup. Empty when no library was left open.

key.name: recent-libraries
key.description: Paths of the libraries opened last, the most recent first.

key.name: recent-libraries-limit
key.description: How many recent libraries the main menu and the welcome page offer. 0 turns the list off.

key.name: show-details
key.description: Whether the panel describing the selected resource is shown next to the grid.

key.name: sort-criterion
key.description: How the resources of the library grid are ordered.

key.name: sort-reversed
key.description: Whether the natural direction of the sort criterion is reversed.

key.name: preview-background
key.description: Background shown behind the resource in the detailed preview.

key.name: preview-bounds
key.description: Whether a dashed outline marks the edges of the resource in the detailed preview.

key.name: preview-pixel-grid
key.description: Whether thin lines separate the pixels of a picture zoomed to 800% or more in the detailed preview.

key.name: collection-sort
key.description: How collections are ordered in the sidebar.

key.name: collection-sort-reversed
key.description: Whether the natural direction of the collection sort criterion is reversed.

key.name: show-counts
key.description: Whether the sidebar shows how many resources each entry contains.

key.name: show-names
key.description: Whether the grid shows the name of each resource under its thumbnail.

key.name: reopen-last-library
key.summary: Reopen the last library at startup
key.description: Whether Pigoune opens the library left open last time instead of its welcome page.

key.name: animate-on-hover
key.description: Whether animated thumbnails play when the pointer is over them in the grid.

key.name: restore-last-view
key.description: Whether the library opens on the last selected sidebar entry instead of All.

key.name: confirm-empty-trash
key.description: Whether Pigoune asks before deleting the resources in the trash for good.

key.name: auto-empty-trash
key.description: Whether resources that have been in the trash for more than 30 days are deleted for good.

key.name: last-view
key.description: The sidebar entry selected when the library was last shown.

key.name: thumbnail-size
key.description: Side of the thumbnails in the library grid, in pixels.

key.name: export-format
key.description: Format last chosen to export resources converted.

key.name: export-quality
key.description: Quality of JPEG and AVIF exports.

key.name: export-background
key.description: Color that fills transparent areas when an export has no transparency.

key.name: export-keep-transparency
key.description: Whether PNG, WebP, AVIF and ICO exports keep transparent areas.

key.name: export-size-unit
key.description: Whether the export width and height are in pixels or a percentage of the original.

key.name: export-icon-sizes
key.description: Sizes, in pixels, gathered in an exported ICO file.
